written.description: The reference framework behind a body of published AI offensive-security research, kept as its final source tree. Its capabilities moved on to a commercial successor.

alive.last_commit_message:
CAI v1.1.5 — final archival snapshot

Cybersecurity AI (CAI) is archived. This single commit consolidates the
complete final state of the project: every file of the last release, the
full documentation set, benchmarks, examples and research material.

CAI was developed by Alias Robotics between March 2025 and August 2026,
across 1,078 commits from 103 authors, and co-funded by the European
Innovation Council Accelerator project RIS (GA 101161136) under the
HORIZON-EIC-2023-ACCELERATOR-01 call. It established Cybersecurity AI as
a research domain, producing 18 papers, 30+ CVEs and #1 rankings in
international security competitions.

The incremental history is not browsable in this snapshot. The published
0.3.9-0.5.10 releases remain on PyPI, and the 275 issues and 195 pull
requests remain public on GitHub.

Work continues in Cybersecurity Superintelligence (CSI):
https://aliasrobotics.com/cybersecuritysuperintelligence.php
